out_of_odd_boundary_strata.safety_note: Undercoverage occurs in far-field (>8.0m); triggers SAFE_REFUSAL under V3.3 boundary rules.

interpretation: Locked calibration factor k=2.42 achieved 95.00% in-sample, but demonstrated empirical undercoverage on out-of-sample data: nominal ODD coverage observed at 92.61% [95% CI: 90.36%-94.36%], falling below the 95.0% pre-registered target. In far-field boundary (>8.0m), coverage degraded to 67.07%. This constitutes an empirical safety finding requiring safe refusal gating rather than assumed universal coverage.
